draft:
**Tidepool landing page — build plan**

**Persistent structure:** Keep the vertical week-timeline sidebar, but make it functional: Mon–Sun nodes down the left, today ringed in coral, each day anchored to a page section (clicking Friday scrolls to retros). Small activity dots on each node hint at team presence.

**1. Hero (right of sidebar):** Deep tide-teal background (#123B3B), seafoam text. Long, run-on conversational headline in the library page's voice, adapted: "Give your team one shared picture of the week that everyone plans into on Monday morning, updates from their own corner all week long, and trusts enough to stop chasing status in chat." Hand-drawn coral arrow loops from headline to a screenshot of the week board. Body type: humanist sans; headline set in a warm serif (Fraunces).

**2. "Plan Monday together":** Alternating feature row, sand background (#F6F1E7). Screenshot of the collaborative Monday planning view. Copy is plain and anti-jargon: fifteen minutes, one board, no standup theater.

**3. "The week adjusts itself":** Teal section. Animate the screenshot: drag a task, watch Wednesday rebalance. Copy emphasizes calm — reassignments, capacity bars, nobody buried.

**4. Pull quote:** Monospace typeface kept deliberately, on seafoam. Something like "we stopped asking 'where are we on this?'" with a name, role, and team size in small caps.

**5. "Friday, look back":** Ties directly to the sidebar's final node. Screenshot of the retro digest — what shipped, what slipped, carried into next Monday. Copy: closing the loop is the whole point.

**6. CTA band:** Coral background, teal type. Short imperative — "Plan next week in one sitting." Email field, no pricing theater for the beta.

**7. Footer:** Minimal, seafoam on teal, with a tiny illustrated tide line echoing the arrow motif.
final:
**Tidepool landing page — revised plan**

Core upgrades: the sidebar becomes the page's narrative spine, and the hand-drawn arrow grows into a full annotation system that carries the whole design.

**Persistent sidebar:** Mon–Fri nodes down the left (weekend compressed into one faded node), today ringed in coral. Each node maps to a page section — the page literally walks through one week. Hovering a node reveals two or three teammate avatars. Navigation becomes storytelling.

**1. Hero — Monday:** Deep tidepool teal (#0E3A3F), seafoam type. Headline in warm serif (Fraunces), matching the library page's full run-on cadence: "Give your small team one shared picture of the week that everyone fills in on Monday morning, reshapes itself as reality hits by Wednesday, and quietly retires the status meeting so nobody ever has to ask what you're working on again." Hand-drawn coral arrow curves from headline to screenshot.

**2. Monday: plan in one sitting:** Sand background (#F6F1E7). Screenshot of the planning board with a "15 min" chip circled in coral. Copy: fifteen minutes, one board, no standup theater.

**3. Tue–Thu: the week adjusts itself:** Teal section. Animated screenshot — drag a task, watch Wednesday rebalance; capacity bars flush coral before anyone overloads. Copy sells calm: reassignments happen in the open, nobody drowns.

**4. Pull quote:** Monospace, kept deliberately because it reads like a real message pasted out of team chat: "we deleted our status meeting and nobody noticed." Seafoam panel; name, role, team size in small caps.

**5. Friday: the retro writes itself:** Sand. Screenshot of the digest — shipped, slipped, carried into Monday — with a coral arrow looping back to the sidebar's Friday node, closing the loop visually.

**Annotation system:** Every screenshot carries hand-drawn coral markup — circles, underlines, margin arrows — as if teammates annotated it live. The library's single arrow becomes Tidepool's signature language. No stock photography anywhere; the product is the imagery.

**6. CTA band:** Coral background, teal type: "Own your next Monday." Email field, beta note, no pricing theater.

**7. Footer:** Seafoam on teal, tiny illustrated tide line echoing the arrow stroke.
